steps.caption: In Matrix, choose Control 1, select Macro 1, and set its depth to 0.10. With Macro 1 at zero, the selected CC stays at 32.

steps.caption: Start the same C3, D3, E3, F3 phrase. The notes and their one-sixth-second spacing stay the same, and CC 1 remains at 32 while the macro is at zero.
steps.title: Hear the unchanged phrase

steps.caption: Set Toolkit Macro 1 to 0.50 and replay. Mosaic sends CC 1 at 38 as playback starts, and the four notes keep their pitches, velocities, timing and gates.
steps.title: Move CC 1 modestly

steps.caption: Clear the Matrix depth and replay. Playback starts by sending CC 1 at 32 while the same four-note phrase continues unchanged.
steps.title: Restore the authored value

steps.caption: With the Matrix route still clear, return Toolkit Macro 1 to 0.0 so the setup is left at its starting value.
steps.title: Leave Macro 1 at zero
